rationale: This is an auto collision claim where a vehicle is the primary object of loss (totaled vehicle with severe structural damage), with injuries sustained by the policyholder.
severity_rationale: Vehicle is a total loss with severe structural damage (trunk crushed into back seat); claimant sustained injuries (whiplash and sprained wrist) requiring medical attention beyond first aid, which elevates this to high severity regardless of repair cost.
claim_summary: High-severity auto collision claim. Policyholder rear-ended at red light on Route 9 yesterday at ~8:15 AM by vehicle traveling ~35 mph with no braking. Claimant's vehicle totaled (trunk crushed into back seat). Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Third-party fault with police report and other driver's insurance information on file. Policy limit $100,000, deductible $750.

case_facts.description: Rear-end collision; other driver was going approximately 35 mph with no braking; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.third_party_fault: Other driver at fault; police report filed with other driver's insurance information

rationale: A vehicle is the primary object of loss and was damaged by a fallen tree; vehicle-related claims classify as auto regardless of the cause.
severity_rationale: Damage to hood and windshield with no total loss or injuries; estimated repair cost likely in the $5,000–$50,000 range.
claim_summary: Maple tree from policyholder's front yard fell in wind and struck parked car, damaging hood and windshield. No injuries; medium severity. $1,000 deductible applies.

case_facts.description: maple tree from policyholder's own yard fell in wind and landed on parked car
